parameters.query:
-- Заявка ещё не отправлена в Telegram и у Заказчика есть группа; иначе 0 строк = стоп.
-- history — последние Сообщения Беседы для сводки Передачи человеку.
select l.id as lead_id, l.status, l.handoff_reason, c.name as company_name, c.telegram_chat_id,
  v.channel, v.sender_id, l.intent,
  l.name, l.contact, l.service, l.description, l.desired_date,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('direction', h.direction, 'text', h.text) order by h.created_at), '[]')
   from (select direction, text, created_at from messages
         where conversation_id = v.id order by created_at desc limit 10) h) as history
from leads l
join companies c on c.id = l.company_id
join conversations v on v.id = l.conversation_id and v.company_id = l.company_id
where l.id = $1::uuid and l.telegram_sent_at is null and c.telegram_chat_id is not null

-- Только после успешного sendMessage: ошибка Bot API остановит workflow раньше.
update leads set telegram_sent_at = now()
where id = $1::uuid and telegram_sent_at is null
returning id as lead_id, telegram_sent_at
